exposure: surgical re-exploration (restaging operation; complete uterine removal)
cohort: The study included 87 patients who underwent re-exploration for incidentally diagnosed uterine leiomyosarcoma (uLMS).
finding: Reoperation with total hysterectomy after incomplete surgery may be helpful in patients with incidentally diagnosed uterine leiomyosarcoma, particularly those who underwent myomectomy/subtotal hysterectomy, showing an association with longer DFS and OS.
